local_review.finding_body: The test build hardcoded 5.1.13 for four Micronaut companion modules. This violated the version-agnostic test requirement because a later tested version would still execute against stale 5.1.13 server, client, Jackson, and injection modules instead of the TCK-resolved library version.
local_review.finding_title: Version-pinned companion dependencies prevent test reuse
local_review.fix_note: Replaced the four hardcoded Micronaut companion dependency versions with $libraryVersion so the complete Micronaut test stack follows tck.testedLibraryVersion. The exact Forge-owned finalization command then completed successfully with no further publishable mutation.
local_review.review_comment: Reviewed the single-coordinate diff and local evidence. The contribution stays within the allowed metadata, stats, index, and test paths; uses only reachability-metadata.json; has a public, library-specific test in a separate package that runs under Native Image; and reports 6/6 dynamic-access calls covered (100%), above the new-library gate. The reported 59 library plus 63 test-only metadata entries do not trigger the entry-count mismatch check. After the repair, the exact Forge finalization command passed all three native test lanes, metadata splitting and validation, style checks, generated-test checks, and library-stat generation without further publishable changes.
